name: Supply Chain Design, Analytics and Management
description: Supply chain strategy, supply chain network design and optimization, transportation and trans-shipment network design, quantitative models; predictive and prescriptive analytics in supply chain, forecasting, demand management, bull-whip effect, MILP and MINLP models of supply chains, supplier selection and order allocation, MCDM techniques; risk and resilience, risk management strategies; sustainable and circular supply chains, SDGs and supply chain, social sustainability.
